additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395603-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Blackscreen problem CRM:00798001586
additional_info.body:
Hi Colleague,
We performed a field service intervention for Ticket ID 0395603, but encountered an issue.
When we arrived on-site, the device's LEDs were green, but the screen was completely black. (HMI's serial number: 21102890000826)
We replaced the HMI with a new one, but the new HMI had pixel issues. This HMI was recently sent from HQ. (HMI’s serial number: 21103427000740)
Since I didn’t have another new HMI with me, I removed the card from the pixel-issue screen and attached it to the screen with the black screen problem. This made the HMI functional. However, the screen still shows dark spots, so it needs to be replaced with a new one. It is working fine for now.
As a result, we will have replaced two HMI and visited the site twice, including the HMI recently sent from HQ.
You can see all photos and videos at the attachment.
With best regards,
